nodes.name: Merge Article Data With AI Analysis

parameters.content:
## Workflow Startup and Data Prep
This section launches the workflow and configures target brands/keywords like Apple and Shopify while loading historical news data from Google Sheets. It prepares both fresh monitoring parameters and duplicate prevention memory ensuring efficient processing from the first news feed fetch.

## RSS Feed Collection and Merging

This section generates Google News RSS URLs for each monitored brand and fetches raw XML feeds in parallel. The merge node then recombines RSS responses with their original keyword context ensuring every article maintains proper brand association throughout processing.

## Priority Filtering and Digest Preparation

This section filters articles keeping only High importance OR Medium with score above 6 then builds formatted Slack/email digests from filtered items. Simultaneously processed articles get logged to Google Sheets ensuring future duplicate prevention while preparing stakeholder-ready notifications.

## News Processing and Deduplication

This section parses Google News RSS XML into structured data then filters invalid articles while removing duplicates against historical log using URL and content hashing. Only clean, unique high-quality news items proceed to AI analysis preventing repeated notifications.

## Digest Delivery

This final section simultaneously delivers the formatted news digest to both Slack channels and email recipients. Stakeholders receive consolidated high-value news updates through their preferred communication channels ensuring timely awareness of critical brand developments.

## AI News Analysis and Processing
This section processes articles through Google Gemini AI generating summaries, sentiment analysis, importance scores, and priority reasoning. It then extracts structured JSON from AI responses and merges insights back with original article data preparing items for importance filtering.

## How Workflow Works
News Monitor for Brands tracks company news across multiple keywords using Google News RSS feeds. It fetches fresh articles for each brand, removes duplicates by comparing against historical Google Sheets log using URL and content hashing, then analyzes each article with Google Gemini AI. The AI generates summaries, sentiment analysis, importance scores (1-10), and priority levels (High/Medium/Low). Only high-importance news passes filtering creating clean Slack and email digests. Every processed article gets logged preventing future duplicates while stakeholders receive actionable intelligence about product launches, crises, competitor moves, and market shifts without noise from low-relevance coverage.
## Setup Steps
1. Configure Keywords Edit Set Monitor Inputs node with target brands/keywords
2. Connect Google Sheets Link Read Existing News Log and Save Processed News Log to your spreadsheet
3. Setup AI Credentials Configure Google Gemini credentials in Analyze News With AI node
4. Configure Slack Channel Select target channel in Send Slack Digest node
5. Add Email Recipients Set recipient emails in Send Email Digest node
6. Test Manual Run Execute workflow manually to verify end-to-end processing
7. Schedule Automation Replace Manual Trigger with Cron node for daily/twice-daily runs
